stage_boundaries.update: incremental refresh or warm preparation after initial compilation
stage_boundaries.retrieval: condition generation excluding compilation and update
stage_boundaries.agent: model and harness execution after condition delivery
stage_boundaries.verification: evaluator scoring and executable checks after agent execution

aggregation_note: trial wall time is end-to-end; stage and tool-call times may be nested and are never added to it
null_measurement: not reported by the harness or provider; never coerce to zero
